verdict.rationale: The evidence documents on-call schedules, mobile schedule views, and a Shift Agent that monitors calendars for conflicts. None of it describes a subscribable calendar feed (iCal/webcal) that syncs an engineer's shifts into a personal calendar. The REST API's ability to find out who is on call is only a developer building block. The Shift Agent's calendar monitoring is an adjacent feature, not a shift export feed.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, my shifts sync to my personal calendar via a feed so I always know when I'm on the hook
